endpoints.response_shape: {alerts: {sentence: string, invoice_id: string, bill_id: string | null, outstanding_balance: number}[], overdue_clients: {invoice_id: string, client_name: string, outstanding_balance: number, days_overdue: number}[]}
endpoints.description: Returns the Who Owes Me home screen: plain-sentence action alerts that tie overdue balances to upcoming bills, and the overdue clients sorted by days overdue, longest first. outstanding_balance = total_fee − advance_paid − sum of received payments; an invoice is overdue when outstanding_balance > 0 and today is after its event_date, and days_overdue = today − event_date in days.

Returns all invoices for the Invoices list screen, each with client name, event date, total fee, advance paid and computed pending_balance = total_fee − advance_paid − sum of received payments, plus its current status.

Creates an invoice from the New Invoice form: rejects the save when advance_paid is negative or greater than total_fee, otherwise sets balance_due = total_fee − advance_paid, status to paid when balance_due is zero and pending otherwise, and records the advance as a received Payment dated today when it is greater than zero; the New Invoice screen then returns to the Invoices list.

endpoints.response_shape: {invoice: Invoice, payments: Payment[], remaining_balance: number, days_overdue: number}
endpoints.description: Returns one invoice for the Invoice Detail screen with its fee, advance paid, remaining_balance = total_fee − advance_paid − sum of received payments (never below zero), its payment history, and days_overdue counted from the due date when the balance remains.

Corrects an invoice's client name, event date, total fee, advance paid or due date from the Invoice Detail screen; rejects the change when advance_paid would exceed total_fee and recalculates balance_due, pending_balance and status.
Removes an invoice the artist created by mistake from the Invoice Detail screen, together with its payment records.
Returns the pre-filled default event date (today) and default advance paid for the New Invoice form so the artist can finish in three taps.
Returns the payment history of one invoice, with each payment's amount and whether it is expected or received, for the Invoice Detail screen.

Records an expected payment against an invoice from the Invoice Detail screen; rejects an amount that is zero or negative or that exceeds the invoice's remaining balance, and saves the payment with status expected.

Marks a payment as received from the Invoice Detail screen by setting status to received, received_on to today and received_at to now; rejects a payment that is already received, and the invoice's remaining balance and status are recalculated (paid when the balance reaches zero).

endpoints.response_shape: {client_name: string, outstanding_balance: number, can_remind: boolean, reminder_text: string}
endpoints.description: Returns a polite WhatsApp payment reminder for the reminder card, built from the client name and outstanding_balance = total_fee − advance_paid − sum of received payments; can_remind is false and reminder_text is empty when that balance is zero or less. Copying the text changes no record.

endpoints.response_shape: {late_bridal_payment: boolean, horizons: {days: number, expected_inflows: number, upcoming_bills: number, net_cash: number}[]}
endpoints.description: Returns the 30, 60 and 90 day cash forecast for the Cash Forecast chart: expected_inflows sums expected payments and pending balances placed on their event dates, upcoming_bills sums unpaid bills due within each horizon, and net_cash = expected_inflows − upcoming_bills; when late_bridal_payment is true the key bridal client's (the invoice with the largest pending balance) inflow is moved 15 days later before the totals are computed.
Returns all bills for the Bills list screen with name, category, amount, due date and paid status.
Adds an upcoming bill such as rent or a cosmetic restock from the New Bill screen with its name, category, amount and due date, saved with status upcoming and is_paid false.
Returns one bill with its name, category, amount, due date and paid status.
Edits a bill's name, category, amount or due date; rejects the edit once the bill is marked paid.
Removes a bill the artist added by mistake from the Bills list.
Marks a bill as paid from the Bills list, setting is_paid to true, status to paid and paid_at to now, and removes it from upcoming bills in the cash forecast; rejects a bill that is already paid.
